title: vignea × ilseana
intro: Vignea × ilseana, commonly known as the "Wild Yam", is a type of flowering plant that is native to the Americas. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including relief from menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and other hormonal imbalances, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vignea × ilseana include its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, as well as its potential to balance hormones and provide relief from digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include diosgenin, a steroid saponin that is responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as alkaloids and glycosides.
